component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: Proclamation
component.source: W. E. Orchard, The Order of Divine Service (1921), A Simple Observance of the Lord's Supper, p. 117 (1 Corinthians 11:26). Lightly modernised.

original.p: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink the cup, ye proclaim the Lord's death till he come.
Prayer pleading the sacrifice of Christ and making offering of self to God.

block.p: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

p.em: Prayer, pleading the sacrifice of Christ and making offering of ourselves to God.
